address: Westhafenplatz 6, Frankfurt on the Main, 60327, Germany
bio: A really cool location - the spot directly on the Westhafen makes the terrace a real highlight! But it's also pleasant to sit in the smartly decorated interior; windows on all sides mean you also have a view of the water from here. The food is international. Furthermore, they also offer valet parking - it's best to put in your request when you make your reservation....
